definitions.explanation: The opening at the top of a volcano (or on its flanks) from which lava, ash, and gases are ejected during an eruption. {噴火口|ふんかこう} refers specifically to the active vent, while the broader bowl-shaped depression that may form around it is more often called {火口|かこう}.

examples.japanese: {噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Smoke is coming out of the crater.

examples.japanese: {噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入る：26367_tachiiru⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧になっている。
examples.english: The area near the crater is off-limits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}{者|しゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{噴出|ふんしゅつ}→噴出：18287_funshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The researchers analyzed the composition of the gases erupting from the volcanic vent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めること⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In large-scale eruptions, multiple craters can sometimes become active simultaneously.

notes:
{噴火口|ふんかこう} is the specific term for the opening through which a volcano erupts. It is formed transparently from ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧ ("eruption") + {口|こう} ("opening, mouth"), with the on'yomi reading こう in this compound.

FORMS:
- ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧ ("eruption") + {口|こう} ("opening") → {噴火口|ふんかこう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{噴出|ふんしゅつ}→噴出：18287_funshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be ejected from the crater
- {噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{覗|のぞ}き{込|こ}む: to peer into the crater
- ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{噴火口|ふんかこう}: an active crater
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: for a new vent to open
- {噴火口|ふんかこう}⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: the vicinity of the crater

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{火口|かこう}→火口：00448_kakou⟧: crater (the broader depression at a volcano's summit; can also include extinct or dormant craters)
- ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧: eruption (the event itself)
- ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧: volcano (the mountain as a whole)
- カルデラ: caldera (a much larger collapse-formed depression)
- ⟦{溶岩|ようがん}→溶岩：13328_yougan⟧: lava
- {火砕流|かさいりゅう}: pyroclastic flow

USAGE:
- {噴火口|ふんかこう} emphasizes the active vent that ejects material; in news reports about ongoing volcanic activity, this is the term most often used.
- ⟦{火口|かこう}→火口：00448_kakou⟧ is more general and can refer to any volcanic crater regardless of activity. In casual speech, ⟦{火口|かこう}→火口：00448_kakou⟧ alone is often sufficient.
- The same kanji compound ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧ also appears in ⟦{大噴火|だいふんか}→大噴火：27350_daifunka⟧ ("major eruption") and ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ ("eruption warning").
